title: Missouri court says father still owes ex-wife $12,969 despite $20,000 bankruptcy deal
summary_full: A Missouri appeals court ruled that a father still owed his ex-wife $12,969.85 despite paying $20,000 under a bankruptcy settlement. The court found that his earlier payments had been wrongly counted twice and ordered a fresh review of additional child support and children's expenses.
